(a) the Δ-nucleus mass splitting is caused by gluon exchange, (b) the ratio of neutron to proton structure functions at x≃1 is also caused by gluon effects, and (c) the spin-dependent structure functions are also caused by gluonic effects.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the spin structure of the nucleon, and in particular the spin content of the nucleon.
the flavour dependence of parton distributions.
the spin and flavour dependence of quark distribution function in the nucleon.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

there is now strong evidence that the spin of the proton is carried mainly by gluons and that this spin is carried mainly by sea-quark pairs, with the valence quark contribution to the spin being small.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
QCD is not only the theory of hadrons and the strong force, but also of the spin structure of the nucleon.
the spin structure of the nucleon is dominated by the spin structure of its constituent quarks, with the gluon contribution to the nucleon spin playing only a minor role.
QCD is a theory of flavour and spin, not just of colour and spin.
The main takeaway from our work is that
flavour-and spin-dependent effects can be understood in a unified framework and that the flavour dependence of the spin-dependent parton distributions is a consequence of gluon exchange.
